en_title: Bloodborne Movie Gets Promising Update from Producer Jacksepticeye
cn_title: 《血源诅咒》电影已敲定编剧导演
subtitle: 为何要改编？
opus_summary: 《血源诅咒》动画电影制片人透露，编剧与导演已就位，故事规划取得进展，主创身份暂未公开。他希望发挥动画的优势，在原作世界中讲述新故事，而非重复游戏剧情。

paragraphs.en: Seán "Jacksepticeye" McLoughlin has provided an exclusive and promising update on the Bloodborne film to IGN.
paragraphs.cn: Seán「Jacksepticeye」McLoughlin向IGN独家透露了《血源诅咒》电影的新进展，消息令人期待。

paragraphs.en: While speaking with IGN about becoming the new elusive target in Hitman (out today), we naturally had to ask McLoughlin for an update on the Bloodborne movie, which he is producing . I pointed out that it's been over six months since the animated film was first announced , and at that time, it didn't have a writer or a director attached. McLoughlin confirmed to IGN that the film now has a writer and a director, and the movie is making great progress.
paragraphs.cn: McLoughlin接受IGN采访，谈到了自己成为《杀手》新一位限时目标的经历，相关内容于今天上线。我们自然也要问问由他担任制片人的《血源诅咒》电影进展如何。我指出，这部动画电影首次公布至今已超过六个月，当时尚未确定编剧和导演。McLoughlin向IGN确认，如今编剧和导演均已就位，电影的筹备也进展顺利。

paragraphs.en: "Things are obviously much more along the pipeline than they were back then," he said. "It's one of those things that I personally would love to just say everything as a fan of this thing, but then there's no expectation, or there's no fun in the process. So we definitely have a lot more stuff mapped out where we're going with the story, and there are people in place to make this thing happen. Hopefully sooner than later, we can have announcements where we talk about who's involved and where it's going, and little teases of the story and where we're at with that.
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「显然，相比当时，项目已经往前推进了不少。作为粉丝，我个人很想把所有事情都告诉大家，但那样一来，就没什么可期待的了，整个过程也少了乐趣。所以，我们确实已经对故事走向做了更多规划，推动项目落地的人也已经就位。希望不用等太久，我们就能公布参与者、项目的发展方向，也稍微透露一些故事内容和目前的进度。」

paragraphs.en: "But I am proud of the work I've been doing on it. I think it's such an interesting job to have, and for me, it's fun to do. It can be really stressful as well at the same time because you're taking on such a monumental IP. And I am just there to be like, 'Hey, we need this pinprick perfect.' Will we ever get something perfect? I don't know. It's probably impossible to get everyone's expectations into one central pillar, but as someone who's brought on to do this job, I'm right in the position where I need to be, and we're poised to have something really cool."
paragraphs.cn: 「不过，我为自己在这个项目中所做的工作感到自豪。我觉得这是一份很有意思的工作，对我来说，做起来也很开心。同时，压力也可能很大，因为你接手的是这样一个举足轻重的IP。而我的职责就是说：我们连最细微的地方都得做到完美。我们最终能做出完美的作品吗？我不知道。要把所有人的期待汇聚到一起，大概是不可能的。但既然受邀来做这份工作，我现在正处在自己该在的位置上，我们也有望做出很酷的东西。」

paragraphs.en: As of right now, the team behind the film is keeping a lid on who the writer and director are. It's unclear when we'll learn more, but there are ample opportunities for reveals on the horizon - perhaps at The Game Awards this December, or during another gaming event next year. Speaking more about how the team is trying to translate Bloodborne to a new medium, McLoughlin noted that there's a big difference in how Bloodborne is an animated movie and Alex Garland's Elden Ring will be live action .
paragraphs.cn: 目前，电影团队仍未公开编剧和导演的身份。我们何时能获知更多消息尚不清楚，不过接下来有不少适合公布消息的机会，比如今年12月的The Game Awards，或明年的其他游戏活动。进一步谈到团队如何尝试用新媒介呈现《血源诅咒》时，McLoughlin指出，《血源诅咒》拍成动画电影，而亚历克斯·加兰执导的《艾尔登法环》将采用真人形式，两者有很大的区别。

paragraphs.en: "We all have pie-in-the-sky dreams of doing that and making a huge story. And I guess we'll see what happens with Elden Ring, but even I don't think they're doing [the entirety of] Elden Ring. I'm sure they pick one part of that to be able to do because I mean, it'll cost you $600 million to do Elden Ring in live action.
paragraphs.cn: 「我们都做过那种不切实际的梦，想把它拍出来，讲一个宏大的故事。我想，我们可以看看《艾尔登法环》会拍成什么样，但就连我也不觉得他们会拍出《艾尔登法环》的全部内容。我相信他们会挑选其中一部分来拍，因为要把《艾尔登法环》拍成真人电影，得花6亿美元(约合人民币40亿元)（人民币换算待核实）。」

paragraphs.en: "It's just the amount of time, effort, pieces moving, the amount of financials needed in place; is it even a smart decision to do it live action at that point, when there's a lot of stuff that you'd be able to do in animation that you can't do in live action, or you wouldn't nail down? And I think Bloodborne specifically is poised to do that well, because there's so much otherworldly aspects in that that would just be so cool to be able to blow the doors off animated rather than being like, 'Okay, put you in front of a green screen, and let's hope for the best.' Now, we can really whittle it down into something cool."
paragraphs.cn: 「光是所需的时间、精力、需要协调的各个环节，以及必须到位的资金，就已经是个问题。既然很多东西用动画能做到，真人拍摄却做不到，或是无法准确呈现，那选择真人电影究竟还明智吗？我觉得《血源诅咒》尤其适合发挥动画的优势，因为它有太多超凡脱俗的元素，用动画放开手脚去呈现会非常酷，而不必把人放到绿幕前，然后祈祷拍出来效果不错。现在，我们可以真正把它打磨成很酷的作品。」

paragraphs.en: On the subject of the Elden Ring film, I also asked if his team has a plan to take any lessons from that project and apply it to the Bloodborne movie, or if there's such a difference in how they're making their respective movies that it won't be applicable.
paragraphs.cn: 说到《艾尔登法环》电影，我还问他，团队是否打算借鉴那个项目的经验，并运用到《血源诅咒》电影中；还是说，两部电影的制作方式差别太大，经验并不适用。

paragraphs.en: "I mean, probably a bit of both. It is sort of a thing that it'll come out before ours. So you look at it and go, 'Okay, well, what did they do? What was their idea? Are we doing the similar things?' But I mean, Bloodborne and Elden Ring are so far apart from each other. The structure maybe is similar, but in terms of story [one is] Victorian England [and the other is] gods and a mountain [which are] very different from each other. So I would like to not take influence too much because you don't want to repeat the same things. And if it comes out, people are going to be upset, happy, indifferent. It's going to be a huge wide gamut of what people enjoy about different things. So hopefully give something people they don't expect, give them something that's interesting. And at the end of the day, it's all 'Why are we adapting it?'
paragraphs.cn: 「我想，大概两者都有一点。它会比我们的电影先上映，所以我们会看看：他们做了什么？他们的构思是什么？我们是不是也在做类似的事？不过，《血源诅咒》和《艾尔登法环》的差别实在太大了。结构或许相似，但故事层面，一个是维多利亚时代的英国，另一个是诸神与一座山，彼此很不一样。所以，我不希望受到太多影响，因为我们不想重复相同的东西。而等电影上映，有人会失望，有人会开心，也有人无动于衷。大家喜欢不同作品的原因千差万别。所以，希望能给观众带来意想不到的、有意思的东西。归根结底，问题始终是：我们为什么要改编它？」

paragraphs.en: "I don't want to adapt something if we're just going to tell the same stories with the same characters over and over and over again. Movies are a completely different medium than video games. What do movies do better than a game does? It's passive versus interactive, so how do we push and pull with that and play with different ideas? I think I don't want to be involved in an adaptation if it doesn't feel like there's a story worth telling within it or if it's not a good idea."
paragraphs.cn: 「如果只是用同样的角色，一遍又一遍地讲同样的故事，那我不想做这样的改编。电影和电子游戏是完全不同的媒介。哪些事情电影比游戏更擅长？一个是被动观看，一个强调互动，那我们该如何利用这种差异，尝试不同的构思？我想，如果一个改编项目里没有值得讲述的故事，或者构思本身不好，我就不想参与。」

paragraphs.en: He went on to note that this isn't the first time he's taken a crack at a video game adaptation, as he'd previously tried to bring Soma to life, as well. Across all of these experiences, he hasn't had any interest in simply redoing the game in a new medium, but instead wants to find new stories that can expand universes, not unlike the Fallout series or the recent Resident Evil film .
paragraphs.cn: 他接着指出，这并不是自己第一次尝试改编电子游戏，此前他也曾尝试将《SOMA》搬上银幕。在这些经历中，他始终无意于换一种媒介把游戏重做一遍，而是想寻找能够拓展原作世界的新故事，就像《辐射》剧集或最近的《生化危机》电影那样。

paragraphs.en: "Whenever there's leeway in the story and there's latitude to tell different tales within universes, I think that's always most interesting. I don't really ever want to take an IP and just redo the game story. I think we've seen that happen so many times. I'm not going to name names of things, but people already have adaptations in their brains, but it just never really works out. Something like Fallout or Resident Evil are really good examples recently of for all intents and purposes, this is that world.
paragraphs.cn: 「只要故事留有余地，能在同一个世界里讲述不同的故事，我觉得这始终是最有意思的。我从来都不想拿到一个IP后，只是把游戏故事再讲一遍。这种事我们已经见过太多次了。我就不点名了，不过大家脑海里已经浮现出一些改编作品，而这种做法总是没能真正奏效。《辐射》或《生化危机》就是近期很好的例子：无论从哪个角度看，它们呈现的就是原作的那个世界。」

paragraphs.en: "We're just shifting the lens a little bit and we get something really interesting within that space. So I think those stories are worth telling because I remember we were at the BAFTA games and Ben Starr did an interview with somebody and he was talking about adaptation, how they shouldn't exist. And then everyone was tweeting at me being like, 'Do you and Ben hate each other now?' And I texted him being like, 'Dude, we're mortal enemies.' But he has the right idea that why are we adapting it is always the number one question."
paragraphs.cn: 「我们只是稍微换个视角，就能在那个世界里找到很有意思的东西。所以，我觉得那些故事值得讲。我记得我们参加英国电影和电视艺术学院游戏奖时，Ben Starr接受了采访，谈到改编作品，认为它们不该存在。然后大家都在X上问我：你和Ben现在是不是互相讨厌了？我还发短信给他，说：兄弟，我们现在是不共戴天的仇敌了。不过，他的思路是对的：我们为什么要改编它，始终是首要问题。」
